units.zh: 崔季舒 祖珽
units.en: Cui Jishu; Zu Ting
units.literal: Cui Jishu; Zu Ting

units.zh: 崔季舒，字叔正，博陵安平人。
units.en: Cui Jishu, styled Shuzheng, came from Anping in Boling commandery.
units.literal: Cui Jishu, styled Shuzheng, was a man of Anping in Boling.

units.zh: 父瑜之，魏鴻臚卿。
units.en: His father Yuzhi had been Wei chamberlain for dependent states.
units.literal: His father Yuzhi was Chamberlain for Dependent States under Wei.

units.zh: 季舒少孤，性明敏，涉獵經史，長於尺牘，有當世才具。
units.en: Orphaned young, Jishu was bright and quick, read widely in classics and histories, wrote excellent dispatches, and had real gifts for his time.
units.literal: Jishu was orphaned young; by nature bright and keen, he ranged through the classics and histories, excelled at correspondence, and had the talent and equipment of his age.

units.zh: 年十七，為州主簿，為大將軍趙郡公琛所器重，言之於神武。
units.en: At seventeen he served as provincial chief clerk. Grand General the Duke of Zhao commandery, Chen, favored him and recommended him to Gao Huan.
units.literal: At seventeen he was chief clerk of the province; the Grand General, Duke of Zhao commandery Chen, valued him highly and spoke of him to Gao Huan.

units.zh: 神武親簡丞郎，補季舒大行臺都官郎中。
units.en: Gao Huan personally screened chancellery and department officers and made Jishu lang in the mobile grand secretariat bureau of offices.
units.literal: Gao Huan personally screened chancellery and department men and appointed Jishu lang in the Mobile Grand Secretariat Bureau of Offices.

units.zh: 文襄輔政，轉大將軍中兵參軍，甚見親寵。
units.en: When Gao Cheng assumed regency, Jishu was moved to staff officer in the grand general central troops bureau and won close favor.
units.literal: When Gao Cheng took up regency he was transferred to staff officer in the grand general central troops bureau and was greatly favored.

units.zh: 以魏帝左右，須置腹心，擢拜中書侍郎。
units.en: The Wei emperor needed trusted men at his side, so Jishu was promoted secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: Because the Wei emperor needed trusted men at his side, Jishu was promoted secretariat gentleman.

units.zh: 文襄為中書監，移門下機事總歸中書，又季舒善音樂，故內伎亦通隸焉，內伎屬中書。
units.en: Gao Cheng supervised the secretariat; secretariat-gate business was folded into it. Because Jishu knew music, inner palace performers also came under him—inner performers now belonged to the secretariat.
units.literal: Gao Cheng was supervisor of the secretariat; the business of the Secretariat Gate was folded into the secretariat, and because Jishu was skilled at music the inner performers also reported through him—the inner performers belonged to the secretariat.

units.zh: 自季舒始也。
units.en: That practice began with Jishu.
units.literal: This began with Jishu.

units.zh: 文襄每進書魏帝，有所諫請，或文辭繁雜，季舒輒修飾通之，得申勸戒而已。
units.en: Whenever Gao Cheng sent the Wei emperor memorials with remonstrance, Jishu would trim tangled wording so the counsel itself could pass.
units.literal: Whenever Gao Cheng presented memorials to the Wei emperor with remonstrances, if the wording grew tangled Jishu would polish and render it clear so only the admonition stood forth.

units.zh: 靜帝報答霸朝，恒與季舒論之，云：「崔中書是我妳母。」
units.en: When Emperor Jing drafted replies to the hegemonic court, he always discussed them with Jishu and said, "Secretariat Gentleman Cui is our wet nurse."
units.literal: Emperor Jing, when answering the hegemonic court, always discussed it with Jishu, saying, "Secretariat Gentleman Cui is our wet nurse."

units.zh: 轉黃門侍郎，領主衣都統。
units.en: He was then made gentleman of the yellow gate and also oversaw the directorate of imperial wardrobe.
units.literal: He was transferred to gentleman of the yellow gate and concurrently oversaw the directorate of imperial wardrobe.

units.zh: 雖迹在魏朝，而心歸霸府，密謀大計，皆得預聞。
units.en: Though he still walked the Wei court, his heart was with the hegemonic government, and he was let in early on major plans.
units.literal: Though his footprints lay in the Wei court, his heart belonged to the hegemonic government; on weighty plans he was always allowed to hear in advance.

units.zh: 於是賓客輻湊，傾心接禮，甚得名譽，勢傾崔暹。
units.en: Guests gathered in force; he met them with open courtesy, won wide renown, and his power eclipsed Cui Xian.
units.literal: Guests then gathered in numbers; he received them with open courtesy and won a great name, until his power outshone Cui Xian.

units.zh: 暹嘗於朝堂屏人拜之曰：「暹若得僕射，皆叔父之恩。」
units.en: Once at court Xian dismissed everyone else and bowed to him, saying, "If Xian wins vice director of the masters of writing, it will be entirely my uncle's favor."
units.literal: Once Xian at the hall dismissed others and bowed to him, saying, "If Xian should obtain vice director of the masters of writing, it is all Uncle's grace."

units.zh: 其權重如此。
units.en: His weight in power was such.
units.literal: Such was his weight in power.

units.zh: 時勳貴多不法，文襄無所縱捨，外議以季舒及崔暹等所為，甚被怨疾。
units.en: Many meritorious nobles then broke the law, and Gao Cheng would not spare them. Outsiders blamed Jishu, Cui Xian, and the rest, and hated them bitterly.
units.literal: At that time many meritorious nobles acted lawlessly; Gao Cheng would not spare them, and outsiders blamed Jishu and Cui Xian and others for it and bitterly resented them.

units.zh: 及文襄遇難，文宣將赴晉陽，黃門郎陽休之勸季舒從行，曰：「一日不朝，其間容刀。」
units.en: When Gao Cheng was killed, Gao Yang was bound for Jinyang. Gentleman of the yellow gate Yang Xiuzhi urged Jishu to go with him, saying, "Miss one day at court and a blade may hide in the interval."
units.literal: When Gao Cheng met disaster, Gao Yang was about to go to Jinyang; Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Yang Xiuzhi urged Jishu to go along, saying, "One day without attending court, and in between a blade may be hidden."

units.zh: 季舒性愛聲色，心在閑放，遂不請行，欲恣其行樂。
units.en: Jishu loved music and women and wanted leisure, so he did not ask to go and meant to enjoy himself.
units.literal: Jishu loved music and women; his heart was set on leisure, so he did not ask to go and meant to indulge his pleasures.

units.zh: 司馬子如緣宿憾，及尚食典御陳山提等共列其過狀，由是季舒及暹各鞭二百，徙北邊。
units.en: Sima Ziru, holding an old grudge, joined Director of Palace Provisions Chen Shanti and others in listing his offenses. Jishu and Xian were each flogged two hundred strokes and exiled north.
units.literal: Sima Ziru, nursing an old grudge, together with Director of Palace Provisions Chen Shanti and others jointly listed his offenses, and thereby Jishu and Xian were each flogged two hundred strokes and sent to the northern marches.

units.zh: 天保初，文宣知其無罪，追為將作大匠，再遷侍中。
units.en: Early in Tianbao, Gao Yang knew they were innocent and recalled Jishu as director of imperial works, then promoted him again to regular attendant.
units.literal: Early in Tianbao Gao Yang knew they were guiltless and recalled Jishu as director of imperial works, then again promoted him to regular attendant.

units.zh: 俄兼尚書左僕射、儀同三司，大被恩遇。
units.en: Soon he was also left vice director of the masters of writing and ceremonial peer of the three ranks, and was deeply favored.
units.literal: Soon he was concurrently made left vice director of the masters of writing and ceremonial peer of the three ranks, and was deeply favored.

units.zh: 乾明初，楊愔以文宣遺旨，停其僕射。
units.en: Early in Qianming, Yang Yin, acting on Gao Yang's final instruction, removed him from vice director.
units.literal: Early in Qianming Yang Yin, on Gao Yang's dying instruction, stopped his vice directorship.

units.zh: 遭母喪解任，起復，除光祿勳，兼中兵尚書。
units.en: He left office for his mother mourning, then was recalled and made director of splendid happiness while also chief of the central troops bureau in the masters of writing.
units.literal: On his mother mourning he left office; recalled from mourning he was made director of splendid happiness and concurrently chief of the central troops bureau in the masters of writing.

units.zh: 出為齊州刺史，坐遣人渡淮互市，亦有贓賄事，為御史所劾，會赦不問。
units.en: Sent out as governor of Qi, he was impeached for sending men across the Huai to trade and for bribery as well, but was pardoned and not pursued.
units.literal: Sent out as governor of Qi province; because he sent men across the Huai for mutual trade and had bribery matters as well, he was impeached by the censorate, but pardoned and not pursued.

units.zh: 武成居藩，曾病，文宣令季舒療病，備盡心力。
units.en: When Gao Zhan held a princely fief he once fell ill; Gao Yang ordered Jishu to treat him, and Jishu spared no effort.
units.literal: When Gao Zhan held a princely fief he once fell ill; Gao Yang ordered Jishu to treat him and he spared no effort.

units.zh: 大寧初，追還，引入慰勉，累拜度支尚書、開府儀同三司。
units.en: Early in Daning he was recalled, comforted at court, and promoted in turn to director of revenue in the masters of writing and grand ceremonial peer with an opened government office.
units.literal: Early in Daning he was recalled, brought in and comforted, and repeatedly promoted to director of revenue in the masters of writing and grand ceremonial peer opening a government office.

units.zh: 營昭陽殿，敕令監造。
units.en: When the Zhaoyang Palace was raised, he was ordered to oversee construction.
units.literal: When the Zhaoyang Palace was being built he was ordered to oversee construction.

units.zh: 以判事式為胡長仁密言其短，出為西兗州刺史。
units.en: Hu Changren privately denounced his faults in a case-review form, and he was sent out as governor of Western Yanzhou.
units.literal: Because in a case-review form Hu Changren privately denounced his faults, he was sent out as governor of Western Yanzhou.

units.zh: 為進典籖於吏部，被責免官，又以詣廣寧王宅，決馬鞭數十。
units.en: As advance registry clerk in the personnel directorate he was rebuked and dismissed; for visiting the Prince of Guangning's mansion he was also sentenced to several dozen horsewhip strokes.
units.literal: Serving as advance registry clerk in the personnel directorate he was rebuked and removed from office; again for visiting the mansion of Prince of Guangning he was sentenced to several dozen strokes of the horsewhip.

units.zh: 及武成崩，不得預於哭泣。
units.en: When Gao Zhan died he was not allowed to join the mourning rites.
units.literal: When Gao Zhan died he was not allowed to take part in the mourning rites.

units.zh: 久之，除膠州刺史，遷侍中、開府，食新安、河陰二郡幹。
units.en: Long afterward he was made governor of Jiao, then regular attendant and grand ceremonial peer, drawing salary from Xin'an and Heyin commanderies.
units.literal: After a long interval he was made governor of Jiao province, then transferred to regular attendant and grand ceremonial peer, with salary from the two commanderies of Xin'an and Heyin.

units.zh: 加左光祿大夫，待詔文林館，監撰《御覽》。
units.en: He was advanced to left grand master of splendid happiness, attended at the Wenslin Hall, and supervised compilation of the Imperial Overview.
units.literal: Advanced to left grand master of splendid happiness, attended at the Wenslin Hall, and supervised compilation of the Imperial Overview.

units.zh: 加特進、監國史。
units.en: He was made special advancement and supervisor of the national history.
units.literal: Made special advancement and supervisor of the national history.

units.zh: 季舒素好圖籍，暮年轉更精勤，兼推薦人士，獎勸文學，時議翕然，遠近稱美。
units.en: Jishu had always loved books and grew keener in old age. He also recommended men and encouraged letters; opinion converged, and praise spread near and far.
units.literal: Jishu had always loved books; in his later years he grew still more diligent, and he also recommended men and encouraged letters—opinion converged, and near and far praised him.

units.zh: 祖珽受委，奏季舒總監內作。
units.en: Zu Ting received a commission and memorialized that Jishu should oversee all inner construction.
units.literal: Zu Ting received a commission and memorialized that Jishu should oversee inner construction altogether.

units.zh: 珽被出，韓長鸞以為珽黨，亦欲出之。
units.en: When Ting was sent out, Han Changluan treated him as Ting's man and wanted to send Jishu out too.
units.literal: When Ting was sent out, Han Changluan thought him an associate of Ting and wished to send Jishu out as well.

units.zh: 屬車駕將適晉陽，季舒與張雕議：以為壽春被圍，大軍出拒，信使往還，須稟節度；
units.en: As the emperor was about to go to Jinyang, Jishu and Zhang Diao argued that with Shouchun besieged and the main army out to resist, couriers would need headquarters orders;
units.literal: As the imperial carriage was about to visit Jinyang, Jishu and Zhang Diao discussed: Shouchun was besieged, the great army went out to resist, and couriers went back and forth requiring orders from headquarters;

units.zh: 兼道路小人，或相驚恐，云大駕向幷，畏避南寇；
units.en: and petty men on the road might panic, saying the court was fleeing to Bing to avoid the southern enemy;
units.literal: moreover petty men on the road might spread alarm, saying the great carriage was heading for Bing, fleeing the southern foe;

units.zh: 若不啟諫，必動人情。
units.en: if no remonstrance were submitted, the people's hearts would surely be shaken.
units.literal: if they did not memorialize in remonstrance, the people's hearts would certainly be shaken.

units.zh: 遂與從駕文官連名進諫。
units.en: They therefore joined the civil officials in the retinue in a joint signed remonstrance.
units.literal: They then joined with the civil officials in the retinue in a joint remonstrance by signature.

units.zh: 時貴臣趙彥深、唐邕、段孝言等初亦同心，臨時疑貳，季舒與爭未決。
units.en: Great ministers Zhao Yanshen, Tang Yong, and Duan Xiaoyan had first agreed, then wavered at the last moment; Jishu argued with them without resolution.
units.literal: At the time the great ministers Zhao Yanshen, Tang Yong, and Duan Xiaoyan had at first agreed in heart, but at the last moment grew doubtful—Jishu disputed with them without decision.

units.zh: 長鸞遂奏云：「漢兒文官連名總署，聲云諫止向幷，其實未必不反，宜加誅戮。」
units.en: Changluan then memorialized: "Han civil officials signed together, claiming to stop the move to Bing, but may in fact be disloyal—they should be executed."
units.literal: Changluan then memorialized, saying, "Han civil officials have jointly signed, voicing remonstrance against going to Bing when in fact they may well not be loyal—they should be put to death."

units.zh: 帝卽召已署表官人集含章殿，以季舒、張雕、劉逖、封孝琰、裴澤、郭遵等為首，並斬之殿庭，長鸞令棄其屍於漳水。
units.en: The emperor at once summoned every official who had signed to the Hange Hall. Jishu, Zhang Diao, Liu Ti, Feng Xiaoyan, Pei Ze, Guo Zun, and others were taken as ringleaders and beheaded in the courtyard; Changluan had their bodies thrown into the Zhang River.
units.literal: The emperor at once summoned the officials who had signed the memorial to gather in the Hange Hall; taking Jishu, Zhang Diao, Liu Ti, Feng Xiaoyan, Pei Ze, Guo Zun, and others as ringleaders, he beheaded them all in the hall courtyard, and Changluan had their corpses cast into the Zhang River.

units.zh: 自外同署，將加鞭撻，趙彥深執諫獲免。
units.en: The rest who had signed were to be flogged too, but Zhao Yanshen insisted in remonstrance and they were spared.
units.literal: The others who had signed beyond that were to be flogged as well; Zhao Yanshen clasped remonstrance and they were spared.

units.zh: 季舒等家屬男女徙北邊，妻女子婦配奚官，小男下蠶室，沒入貲產。
units.en: The households of Jishu and the others, men and women, were sent north; wives, daughters, and daughters-in-law were assigned to tribal wardens, young sons to the silkworm chamber, and property was confiscated.
units.literal: The households of Jishu and the rest, men and women, were sent to the northern marches; wives, daughters, and daughters-in-law were assigned to tribal wardens, young sons cast into the silkworm chamber, and property confiscated.

units.zh: 季舒大好醫術，天保中，於徙所無事，更銳意研精，遂為名手，多所全濟。
units.en: Jishu loved medicine deeply. In Tianbao, idle in exile, he studied harder still and became a master who saved many lives.
units.literal: Jishu greatly loved medicine; in the Tianbao era, idle at his place of exile, he studied with sharpened purpose and became a master hand, saving many lives.

units.zh: 雖位望轉高，未曾懈怠，縱貧賤廝養，亦為之療。
units.en: Though rank and reputation rose, he never slackened; he treated even poor servants.
units.literal: Though his status and hopes grew higher, he never slackened; even for the poor and lowly in service he treated them.

units.zh: 庶子長君，尚書右外兵郎中。
units.en: His secondary son Changjun was Gentleman of the Right Outer Military Bureau of the Secretariat.
units.literal: His secondary son Changjun was Gentleman of the Right Outer Military Bureau of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 次鏡玄，著作佐郎。
units.en: Next came Jingxuan, assistant in the compositions office.
units.literal: Next Jingxuan was assistant in the compositions office.

units.zh: 並流於遠惡。
units.en: Both were exiled to the far frontier.
units.literal: Both were exiled to the far frontier.

units.zh: 未幾，季舒等六人妻以年老放出。
units.en: Before long the wives of the six, being old, were released.
units.literal: Before long the wives of the six men of Jishu and the rest, being old, were released.

units.zh: 後南安王思好更稱朝廷罪惡，以季舒等見害為詞，悉召六人兄弟子侄隨軍趣晉陽。
units.en: Later Prince of Nanan Sihao again denounced the court crimes, citing the killing of Jishu and the others, and summoned the six men brothers and nephews to follow his army toward Jinyang.
units.literal: Later Prince of Nanan Sihao again charged the court with crimes, taking the harm done to Jishu and the others as his pretext, and summoned the brothers and nephews of the six men to follow the army toward Jinyang.

units.zh: 事敗，長君等並從戮，六人妻又追入官。
units.en: When the affair failed, Changjun and the rest were executed with him, and the six wives were taken back into palace service.
units.literal: When the affair failed, Changjun and the rest were all killed with him; the wives of the six men were again taken into service in the palace.

units.zh: 周武帝滅齊，詔斛律光與季舒等六人同被優贈，季舒贈開府儀同大將軍、定州刺史云。
units.en: When Emperor Wu of Zhou destroyed Qi, an edict granted generous posthumous honors to Hulü Guang and six men including Jishu; Jishu was posthumously granted Kaifu Yitong Grand General and Inspector of Ding Province.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu of Zhou destroyed Qi, an edict granted generous posthumous honors to Hulü Guang and six men including Jishu; Jishu was posthumously granted Kaifu Yitong Grand General and Inspector of Ding Province.

units.zh: 祖珽，字孝征，范陽狄遒人也。
units.en: Zu Ting, styled Xiaozheng, came from Di Dao in Fanyang.
units.literal: Zu Ting, styled Xiaozheng, was a man of Di Dao in Fanyang.

units.zh: 父瑩，魏護軍將軍。
units.en: His father Ying was Wei defender-general.
units.literal: His father Ying was defender-general of Wei.

units.zh: 珽神情機警，詞藻遒逸，少馳令譽，為世所推。
units.en: Ting was quick-witted and alert, his phrasing forceful and fluent; from youth he won fame and the age praised him.
units.literal: Ting was alert in spirit and quick in wit, his diction forceful and fluent; from youth he won a fine reputation and was praised by the world.

units.zh: 起家秘書郎，對策高第，為尚書儀曹郎中，典儀注。
units.en: He began as secretariat lang, ranked high in the policy examination, and became lang in the ritual protocols section of the masters of writing, in charge of ceremonial regulations.
units.literal: He first took office as secretariat lang; in the policy-response examination he ranked high and became lang in the ritual protocols section of the masters of writing, in charge of ceremonial regulations.

units.zh: 嘗為冀州刺史万俟受洛制《清德頌》，其文典麗，由是神武聞之。
units.en: He once composed the "Eulogy of Pure Virtue" for Moqi Shouluo, Inspector of Ji Province. Its writing was elegant, and because of this Gao Huan heard of him.
units.literal: He once composed the "Eulogy of Pure Virtue" for Moqi Shouluo, Inspector of Ji Province. Its writing was elegant, and because of this Gao Huan heard of him.

units.zh: 時文宣為幷州刺史，署珽開府倉曹參軍。
units.en: At that time Gao Yang was governor of Bing and appointed Ting army-camp staff officer with an opened government office.
units.literal: At that time Gao Yang was governor of Bing province and appointed Ting as army-camp staff officer of an opened government office.

units.zh: 神武口授珽三十六事，出而疏之，一無遺失，大為僚類所賞。
units.en: Gao Huan dictated thirty-six items to Ting; Ting wrote them into a memorial without losing one, and colleagues admired him greatly.
units.literal: Gao Huan dictated thirty-six items to Ting; when he came out Ting wrote them up in a memorial and not one was lost—greatly admired by colleagues.

units.zh: 時神武送魏蘭陵公主出塞嫁蠕蠕，魏收賦《出塞》及《公主遠嫁詩》二首，珽皆和之，大為時人傳詠。
units.en: Then Gao Huan was sending Princess Lanling of Wei beyond the frontier to marry the Rouran. Wei Shou wrote "Crossing the Frontier" and "The Princess Far Marriage"; Ting harmonized with both, and the age chanted them widely.
units.literal: Then Gao Huan was sending Princess Lanling of Wei beyond the frontier to marry the Rouran; Wei Shou composed two pieces, "Crossing the Frontier" and "The Princess Far Marriage"; Ting harmonized with both, and they were widely chanted in the age.

units.zh: 珽性疏率，不能廉慎守道。
units.en: Ting was careless by nature and could not keep office with integrity and caution.
units.literal: Ting was by nature careless and coarse, unable to keep integrity and caution in office.

units.zh: 倉曹雖云州局，乃受山東課輸，由此大有受納，豐於財產。
units.en: Though the army-camp post was called a provincial bureau, he took levies from east of the mountains, accepted bribes in quantity, and grew very rich.
units.literal: Though the army-camp post was called a provincial bureau, he received the levies from east of the mountains and thereby took bribes in great quantity, growing rich in assets.

units.zh: 又自解彈琵琶，能為新曲，招城市年少歌舞為娛，遊集諸倡家。
units.en: He could play pipa and compose new tunes, gathered city youths to sing and dance for pleasure, and haunted singing-houses.
units.literal: He himself could play the pipa and compose new tunes; he summoned city youths to sing and dance for pleasure and frequented every singing-house.

units.zh: 與陳元康、穆子容、任胄、元士亮等為聲色之遊。
units.en: With Chen Yuankang, Mu Zirong, Ren Zhou, Yuan Shiliang, and others he pursued music and women.
units.literal: With Chen Yuankang, Mu Zirong, Ren Zhou, Yuan Shiliang, and others he indulged in music and women.

units.zh: 諸人嘗就珽宿，出山東大文綾幷連珠孔雀羅等百餘疋，令諸嫗擲樗蒲賭之，以為戲樂。
units.en: When they once lodged with him, he brought out east-of-the-mountains damask and linked-pearl peacock gauze, more than a hundred bolts, and had the women gamble at dice for sport.
units.literal: When the men once lodged with Ting, he brought out from east of the mountains large-pattern damask and linked-pearl peacock gauze and the like, more than a hundred bolts, and had the women cast dice for stakes as a pastime.

units.zh: 參軍元景獻，故尚書令元世雋子也，其妻司馬慶雲女，是魏孝靜帝姑博陵長公主所生。
units.en: Staff officer Yuan Jingxian was son of former Minister over the Masses Yuan Shijun; his wife was daughter of Sima Qingyun, child of Emperor Jing's aunt, the great Princess of Boling.
units.literal: Staff officer Yuan Jingxian was son of the former minister over the masses Yuan Shijun; his wife was daughter of Sima Qingyun, born of the former Wei Emperor Jing's aunt, the Great Princess of Boling.

units.zh: 珽忽迎景獻妻赴席，與諸人遞寢，亦以貨物所致。
units.en: Ting suddenly brought Jingxian wife to the feast and passed her among the company in turn—again for gain.
units.literal: Ting suddenly brought Jingxian wife to the feast and shared her in turn with the company—this too came from greed for goods.

units.zh: 其豪縱淫逸如此。
units.en: His license was such.
units.literal: So wild and dissolute was he.

units.zh: 常云：「丈夫一生不負身。」
units.en: He often said, "A man lives once and must not betray his body."
units.literal: He often said, "A man in one lifetime must not fail his person."

units.zh: 已文宣罷州，珽例應隨府，規為倉局之間，致請於陳元康，元康為白，由是還任倉曹。
units.en: After Gao Yang left the province Ting should have followed headquarters, but schemed for the grain-store post through Chen Yuankang, who spoke for him, and he returned to army-camp duty.
units.literal: After Gao Yang left his provincial post Ting should by rule follow the headquarters; scheming for the grain-store post, he made request through Chen Yuankang, and Yuankang spoke for him, so he returned to the army-camp post.

units.zh: 珽又委體附參軍事攝典簽陸子先，並為畫計，請糧之際，令子先宣教，出倉粟十車，為僚官捉送。
units.en: Ting also attached himself to chief registry clerk Lu Zixian, acting military staff officer, and they plotted together; when grain was requested Zixian proclaimed the order, ten cartloads were issued, and colleagues seized them for trial.
units.literal: Ting also threw himself on Chief Registry Clerk Lu Zixian, who held acting military staff duties, and together they drew up plans; at the time of requesting grain he had Zixian proclaim the order, and ten cartloads of granary grain were issued—caught by a colleague and sent for trial.

units.zh: 神武親問之，珽自言不受署，歸罪子先，神武信而釋之。
units.en: Gao Huan questioned him in person. Ting said he had no commission and blamed Zixian; Gao Huan believed him and released him.
units.literal: Gao Huan questioned him in person; Ting said himself he had not received appointment and blamed Zixian, and Gao Huan believed him and released him.

units.zh: 珽出而言曰：「此丞相天緣明鑒，然實孝徵所為。」
units.en: Coming out he said, "The chancellor heaven-sent clarity sees through—but in truth Xiaozheng did it."
units.literal: Coming out he said, "This chancellor heaven-bestowed discernment—but in truth Xiaozheng did it."

units.zh: 性不羈放縱，曾至膠州刺史司馬世雲家飲酒，遂藏銅疊二面。
units.en: Unrestrained by nature, he once drank at Jiao governor Sima Shiyun home and hid two bronze mirrors.
units.literal: Unrestrained by nature, he once drank at the home of Governor of Jiao province Sima Shiyun and hid two bronze mirrors.

units.zh: 廚人請搜諸客，果於珽懷中得之，見者以為深恥。
units.en: The cook asked to search the guests; they were found in Ting bosom, and onlookers thought it deep shame.
units.literal: The cook asked to search the guests; they were indeed found in Ting bosom, and witnesses thought it a deep shame.

units.zh: 所乘老馬，常稱騮駒。
units.en: The old horse he rode he always called a piebald colt.
units.literal: The old horse he rode he always called a piebald colt.

units.zh: 又與寡婦王氏姦通，每人前相聞往復。
units.en: He also lay with the widow Wang, exchanging messages openly before others.
units.literal: He also committed adultery with the widow surnamed Wang, each time exchanging word before others.

units.zh: 裴讓之與珽早狎，於衆中嘲珽曰：「卿那得如此詭異，老馬十歲，猶號騮駒；
units.en: Pei Rangzhi, long intimate with him, mocked him before the crowd: "How can you be so strange—a ten-year horse still called a piebald colt;
units.literal: Pei Rangzhi was early intimate with Ting and before the crowd mocked him, saying, "How can you be so strange—an old horse of ten years still called a piebald colt;

units.zh: 一妻耳順，尚稱娘子。」
units.en: a sixty-year wife still called Mistress."
units.literal: a wife at sixty still called Mistress."

units.zh: 于時喧然傳之。
units.en: The crowd roared and the story spread.
units.literal: At the time it spread with a roar.

units.zh: 後為神武中外府功曹，神武宴僚屬，於坐失金叵羅，竇泰令飲酒者皆脫帽，於珽髻上得之，神武不能罪也。
units.en: Later he was merit officer in Gao Huan inner and outer government office. At a feast Gao Huan lost a gold bowl; Dou Tai made every drinker remove his cap—it was found in Ting's hair; Gao Huan could not punish him.
units.literal: Later he was merit officer in Gao Huan inner and outer government office; at a feast of subordinates Gao Huan lost a gold bowl, and Dou Tai ordered all who drank to remove their caps—in Ting topknot it was found; Gao Huan could not punish him.

units.zh: 後為秘書丞，領舍人，事文襄。
units.en: Later he was secretariat assistant, leading gentlemen-in-attendance, serving Gao Cheng.
units.literal: Later he was secretariat assistant and led gentlemen-in-attendance, serving Gao Cheng.

units.zh: 州客至，請賣《華林遍略》。
units.en: A provincial visitor came offering to sell the Forest Compendium.
units.literal: A provincial visitor came asking to sell the Forest Compendium.

units.zh: 文襄多集書人，一日一夜寫畢，退其本曰：「不須也。」
units.en: Gao Cheng gathered copyists and finished a copy in one day and one night, then returned the original, saying, "Not needed."
units.literal: Gao Cheng gathered many copyists and in one day and one night finished the copy, then returned the original, saying, "Not needed."

units.zh: 珽以《遍略》數帙質錢樗蒲，文襄杖之四十。
units.en: Ting pledged several volumes of the Compendium for dice gambling; Gao Cheng had him flogged forty strokes.
units.literal: Ting pledged several volumes of the Compendium for dice stakes; Gao Cheng had him flogged forty.

units.zh: 又與令史李雙、倉督成祖等作晉州啟，請粟三千石，代功曹參軍趙彥深宣神武教，給城局參軍事過典簽高景略，疑其定不實，密以問彥深，彥深答都無此事，遂被推檢，珽卽引伏。
units.en: Again with clerk Li Shuang, granary overseer Cheng Zu, and others he drafted a Jinzhou memorial for three thousand shi of grain; standing in for merit officer Zhao Yanshen he proclaimed Gao Huan order to garrison merit officer and passing registry clerk Gao Jinglue. Jinglue doubted the amount, secretly asked Yanshen, and Yanshen said there was no such order. Investigation followed, and Ting confessed at once.
units.literal: Again with clerk Li Shuang, granary overseer Cheng Zu, and others he drafted a Jinzhou memorial requesting three thousand shi of grain; standing in for merit officer Zhao Yanshen he proclaimed Gao Huan order and gave it to garrison-bureau merit officer and passing registry clerk Gao Jinglue, who doubted the quota was not real and secretly asked Yanshen; Yanshen answered there was no such matter at all—thereupon investigation was pushed, and Ting confessed at once.

units.zh: 神武大怒，決鞭二百，配甲坊，加鉗，其穀倍徵。
units.en: Gao Huan was furious: two hundred strokes, assignment to the armor ward, irons added, and the grain levied at double.
units.literal: Gao Huan was greatly angered; sentenced him to two hundred strokes, assigned to the armor ward, and iron added; the grain was levied at double.

units.zh: 未及科，會幷州定國寺新成，神武謂陳元康、溫子升曰：「昔作《芒山寺碑》文，時稱妙絕，今《定國寺碑》當使誰作詞也？」
units.en: Before the levy was collected, the new Dingguo Temple in Bingzhou was finished. Gao Huan said to Chen Yuankang and Wen Zisheng, "The Mangshan Temple stele was called peerless—who should write the Dingguo Temple stele now?"
units.literal: Before the levy was exacted, the new Dingguo Temple in Bingzhou was completed; Gao Huan said to Chen Yuankang and Wen Zisheng, "When we composed the Mangshan Temple stele text it was called peerless—now for the Dingguo Temple stele whose words should compose it?"

units.zh: 元康因薦珽才學，並解鮮卑語。
units.en: Yuankang recommended Ting learning and said he also understood Xianbei.
units.literal: Yuankang thereupon recommended Ting learning and that he also understood Xianbei speech.

units.zh: 乃給筆札就禁所具草。
units.en: Brush and paper were sent, and he drafted it in confinement.
units.literal: Brush and paper were given and in the prison ward the draft was produced.

units.zh: 二日內成，其文甚麗。
units.en: He finished in two days; the text was very fine.
units.literal: Within two days it was finished; the text was very beautiful.

units.zh: 神武以其工而且速，特恕不問，然猶免官，散參相府。
units.en: Gao Huan, impressed by his skill and speed, especially pardoned him, though he still removed him from office to serve scattered in the chancellor office.
units.literal: Gao Huan, because he was skilled and swift, especially pardoned and did not pursue, yet still removed him from office to serve scattered in the chancellor office.

units.zh: 文襄嗣事，以為功曹參軍。
units.en: When Gao Cheng took up the succession he made him army-camp merit officer.
units.literal: When Gao Cheng took up the succession he made him merit officer in the army-camp.

units.zh: 及文襄遇害，元康被傷創重，倩珽作書屬家累事，幷云：「祖喜邊有少許物，宜早索取。」
units.en: When Gao Cheng was killed Yuankang wounds were grave; he had Ting write a letter entrusting family matters, and also said, "Zu Xi at the border has a little property—take it soon."
units.literal: When Gao Cheng met disaster Yuankang wounds were grave; he had Ting compose a letter entrusting family burdens, and also said, "At the border Zu Xi has a little property—take it soon."

units.zh: 珽乃不通此書，喚祖喜私問，得金二十五鋌，唯與喜二鋌，餘盡自入己。
units.en: Ting did not deliver the letter but summoned Zu Xi privately; he got twenty-five ingots of gold, gave Xi only two, and kept the rest.
units.literal: Ting did not deliver this letter but summoned Zu Xi in private to ask; he got twenty-five ingots of gold and gave Xi only two—the rest all entered his own purse.

units.zh: 又盜元康家書數千卷。
units.en: He also stole several thousand scrolls from Yuankang's house.
units.literal: He also stole several thousand scrolls of books from Yuankang's house.

units.zh: 祖喜懷恨，遂告元康二弟叔諶、季璩等。
units.en: Zu Xi nursed a grudge and told Yuan Kang's younger brothers Shu Chen and Ji Qu, among others.
units.literal: Zu Xi bore a grudge and thereupon informed Yuan Kang's two younger brothers, Shu Chen and Ji Ji, and the others.

units.zh: 叔諶以語楊愔，愔嚬眉答曰：「恐不益亡者。」
units.en: Shu Chen told Yang Yin. Yin knit his brow and said, "I doubt that will help the dead."
units.literal: Shu Chen told Yang Yin; Yin frowned and answered, "I fear it will not benefit the dead."

units.zh: 因此得停。
units.en: On that account the matter was dropped.
units.literal: Because of this it was halted.

units.zh: 文宣作相，珽擬補令史十餘人，皆有受納，據法處絞，上尋捨之。
units.en: When Wenxuan was regent, Ting proposed more than ten clerk appointments, every one of them bought. By law they merited strangulation, but in the end the sovereign let them off.
units.literal: When Wenxuan was regent, Ting proposed to fill more than ten clerk posts; all had taken bribes; by law they should be strangled, but the sovereign eventually pardoned them.

units.zh: 又盜官《遍略》一部。
units.en: He also stole an office copy of the Comprehensive Digest.
units.literal: He also stole one copy of the official Comprehensive Digest from the office.

units.zh: 事發，文宣付從事中郎王土雅推檢，並書與平陽公淹，令錄珽付禁，勿令越逸。
units.en: When the theft came to light, Wenxuan put Attendant of the Masters of Writing Wang Tuya in charge of the inquiry and wrote Prince of Pingyang Yan as well, telling him to take Ting into custody and allow no escape.
units.literal: When it came to light, Wenxuan entrusted Attendant of the Masters of Writing Wang Tuya to investigate, and also wrote to Prince of Pingyang Yan, ordering him to take Ting into custody and not allow escape.

units.zh: 淹遣田曹參軍孫子寬往喚，珽受命，便爾私逃。
units.en: Yan sent field officer Sun Zikuan to fetch him. Ting answered the summons, then slipped away the same night.
units.literal: Yan sent Field Officer Sun Zikuan to summon him; Ting accepted the summons, then at once fled in secret.

units.zh: 黃門郎高德正副留臺事，謀云：「珽自知有犯，驚竄是常，但宣一命向秘書，稱『奉幷州約束頒《五經》三部，仰丞親檢校催遣』，如此則珽意安，夜當還宅，然後掩取。」
units.en: Yellow gate gentleman Gao Dezheng was deputy for affairs at the secondary capital. They plotted: "Ting knows he is guilty and will bolt—that is only natural. But issue an order to the secretariat, saying, 'By Bingzhou's command, distribute three sets of the Five Classics; the deputy director is to inspect and hurry delivery in person.' Then Ting will feel safe, come home at night, and we can take him."
units.literal: Yellow Gate Gentleman Gao Dezheng was deputy for matters at the secondary capital; they plotted, saying, "Ting knows his guilt—panic flight is only natural, but proclaim an order to the Secretariat, saying, 'By Bingzhou constraint, distribute three sets of the Five Classics; the Deputy Director is to inspect and expedite in person'—thus Ting will feel secure and return home at night; then seize him."

units.zh: 珽果如德正圖，遂還宅。
units.en: Ting did exactly as Dezheng had planned and went home.
units.literal: Ting did indeed follow Dezheng's plan and returned home.

units.zh: 薄晚，就家掩之，縛珽送廷尉。
units.en: Near dusk they raided his house, bound him, and sent him to the minister of justice.
units.literal: Toward evening they raided his house, bound Ting, and sent him to the Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 據犯枉法處絞刑。
units.en: By the charges, his illegal acts called for strangulation.
units.literal: According to the crimes, illegal conduct warranted strangulation.

units.zh: 文宣以珽伏事先世，諷所司命特寬其罰，遂奏免死除名。
units.en: Wenxuan, because Ting had served the house in earlier reigns, hinted that the office should show special leniency. The memorial asked to spare his life and strike his name from the rolls.
units.literal: Wenxuan, because Ting had served previous generations, hinted to the office to specially mitigate the punishment; a memorial was submitted to spare death and remove his name from the register.

units.zh: 天保元年，復被召從駕，依除免例，參於晉陽。
units.en: In Tianbao's first year he was summoned again to follow the carriage. Under the usual rule for men struck from office, he took part at Jinyang.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianbao he was again summoned to follow the imperial carriage; by precedent for removal from office he participated at Jinyang.

units.zh: 珽天性聰明，事無難學，凡諸伎藝，莫不措懷，文章之外，又善音律，解四夷語及陰陽占侯，醫藥之術尤是所長。
units.en: Ting was clever by nature; nothing was hard for him to learn. Of every craft and art he took hold; beyond letters he knew music, the tongues of the four quarters, and yin-yang divination—and medicine above all was what he did best.
units.literal: Ting was naturally clever; nothing was hard for him to learn; of every craft and skill none did he neglect to take up; beyond literature he was skilled at music, understood the languages of the four barbarians and yin-yang divination, and medicine above all was his forte.

units.zh: 文宣帝雖嫌其數犯憲，而愛其才伎，令直中書省，掌詔誥。
units.en: Emperor Wenxuan disliked how often Ting broke the law, yet loved his talents and kept him in the secretariat drafting edicts.
units.literal: Emperor Wenxuan, though he disliked Ting's repeated violations of law, loved his talents and skills and ordered him to serve directly in the Secretariat, drafting edicts.

units.zh: 珽通密狀，列中書侍郎陸元規，敕令裴英推問，元規以應對忤旨，被配甲坊。
units.en: Ting sent a secret denunciation of secretariat attendant Lu Yuangui. An edict ordered Pei Ying to question him. Yuangui's answers offended the throne and he was sent to the works compound.
units.literal: Ting sent a secret report denouncing Secretariat Attendant Lu Yuangui; an edict ordered Pei Ying to interrogate him; Yuangui, in answering, offended the intent and was assigned to the works compound.

units.zh: 除珽尚藥丞，尋遷典禦。
units.en: Ting was made superintendent of medicines and soon promoted to director of the imperial pharmacy.
units.literal: Ting was appointed Superintendent of Medicines; soon he was promoted to Imperial Pharmacy Director.

units.zh: 又奏造胡桃油，復為割藏免官。
units.en: He also memorialized to supply walnut oil and again lost his post for skimming the storehouses.
units.literal: He also memorialized to make walnut oil and again was removed from office for embezzling from the storehouses.

units.zh: 文宣每見之，常呼為賊。
units.en: Whenever Wenxuan saw him he called him "thief."
units.literal: Whenever Wenxuan saw him he always called him "thief."

units.zh: 文宣崩，普選勞舊，除為寧武太守。
units.en: When Wenxuan died, in the general selection of old servants he was made administrator of Ningwu.
units.literal: When Wenxuan died, in the general selection of meritorious veterans he was made Administrator of Ningwu.

units.zh: 會楊愔等誅，不之官，授著作郎。
units.en: Yang Yin and the others were executed just then; he never took up the post and was made a compiler in the writings office.
units.literal: It happened that Yang Yin and the others were executed; he did not take up the post and was appointed Compiler in the Writings Office.

units.zh: 數上密啟，為孝昭所忿，勑中書門下二省斷珽奏事。
units.en: He sent secret memorials again and again until Emperor Xiaozhao grew furious. An edict barred the secretariat and masters of writing from accepting his papers.
units.literal: He repeatedly sent secret memorials and incurred Emperor Xiaozhao's resentment; an edict ordered the Secretariat and the Masters of Writing to cut off Ting's access to memorials.

units.zh: 珽善為胡桃油以塗畫，乃進之長廣王，因言「殿下有非常骨法，孝徵夢殿下乘龍上天」。
units.en: Ting knew how to make walnut oil for painting and offered it to the Prince of Changguang, saying, "Your Highness has the bones of an uncommon man. I, Xiaozheng, dreamed you rode a dragon into heaven."
units.literal: Ting was skilled at making walnut oil for painting and presented it to the Prince of Changgang, saying, "Your Highness has extraordinary bone structure; Xiao Zheng dreamed that Your Highness rode a dragon into heaven."

units.zh: 王謂曰：「若然，當使兄大富貴。」
units.en: The prince said, "If that is so, my elder brother should grow very rich indeed."
units.literal: The prince said to him, "If that is so, then my elder brother ought to grow very rich."

units.zh: 及卽位，是為武成皇帝，擢拜中書侍郎。
units.en: When he took the throne as Emperor Wucheng, he promoted Ting to secretariat attendant.
units.literal: When he took the throne he was Emperor Wucheng and promoted Ting to Secretariat Attendant.

units.zh: 帝於後園使珽彈琵琶，和士開胡舞，各賞物百段。
units.en: In the rear garden the emperor had Ting play the pipa while He Shikai danced the Hu step. Each man received a hundred bolts of goods.
units.literal: The emperor had Ting play the pipa in the rear garden while He Shikai performed Hu dance; each was rewarded with a hundred bolts of goods.

units.zh: 士開忌之，出為安德太守，轉齊郡太守，以母老乞還侍養，詔許之。
units.en: Shikai envied him and sent him out as administrator of Ande, then moved him to Qi commandery. His mother was old; he begged to return and tend her, and the edict allowed it.
units.literal: Shikai envied him and had him sent out as Administrator of Ande, then transferred to Administrator of Qi commandery; because his mother was old he begged to return and serve her, and an edict permitted it.

units.zh: 會江南使人來聘，為中勞使。
units.en: When envoys came from the south on a courtesy mission, he was made commissioner for receiving them.
units.literal: It happened that envoys from the south came on a mission of courtesy; he was made commissioner for receiving guests.

units.zh: 尋為太常少卿、散騎常侍、假儀同三司，掌詔誥。
units.en: Soon he was vice director of the imperial ancestral temple, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, and acting three excellencies of honor, drafting edicts.
units.literal: Soon he was Vice Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, and Acting Three Excellencies of Honor, drafting edicts.

units.zh: 初，珽於乾明、皇建之時，知武成陰有大誌，遂深自結納，曲相祗奉。
units.en: Early in the Qianming and Huangjian reigns Ting saw that Wucheng nursed great designs in secret and bound himself to him, flattering him at every turn.
units.literal: At first, during the Qianming and Huangjian eras, Ting knew that Wucheng harbored great designs in secret and therefore bonded with him deeply, currying favor with obsequious devotion.

units.zh: 武成於天保世頻被責，心常銜之。
units.en: In the Tianbao years Wucheng had been blamed again and again and carried the grudge in his heart.
units.literal: Wucheng in the Tianbao era had often been blamed and always harbored resentment in his heart.

units.zh: 珽至是希旨，上書請追尊太祖獻武皇帝為神武，高祖文宣皇帝改為威宗景烈皇帝，以悅武成，從之。
units.en: Ting now played to the throne and memorialized to posthumously honor Grand Ancestor Emperor Xianwu as Emperor Shenwu and change High Ancestor Emperor Wenxuan's temple style to Weizong Jinglie Emperor. Wucheng was pleased and assented.
units.literal: Ting now toed the emperor's wishes memorialized to posthumously honor Grand Ancestor as Emperor Shenwu and change High Ancestor Emperor Wenxuan's title to Weizong Jinglie Emperor, to please Wucheng; the emperor assented.

units.zh: 時皇后愛少子東平王儼，願以為嗣，武成以後主體正居長，難於移易。
units.en: The empress then doted on her younger son, Prince Dongping Yan, and wanted him for heir. Wucheng, because the Later Sovereign stood first in proper order, found the succession hard to move.
units.literal: At the time the empress loved her younger son, Prince Dongping Yan, and wished to make him heir; Wucheng, because the Later Sovereign by proper succession was eldest, found it hard to shift the succession.

units.zh: 珽私於士開曰：「君之寵幸，振古無二，宮車一日晚駕，欲何以克終？」
units.en: Ting said privately to He Shikai, "Your favor has no match in all antiquity. When the carriage halts one evening, how will you finish your days?"
units.literal: Ting said privately to Shikai, "Your favor is unmatched in all antiquity; when the imperial carriage one day halts at evening, how will you see it through to the end?"

units.zh: 士開因求策焉。
units.en: Shikai thereupon asked him for a plan.
units.literal: Shikai thereupon asked him for a stratagem.

units.zh: 珽曰：「宜說主上，云襄、宣、昭帝子俱不得立，今宜命皇太子早踐大位，以定君臣。
units.en: Ting said, "Persuade the sovereign that the sons of Emperor Xiang, Emperor Xuan, and Emperor Zhao could none of them take the throne. Now the crown prince should ascend early and fix ruler and minister in their places.
units.literal: Ting said, "You should persuade the sovereign, saying that the sons of Emperor Xiang, Emperor Xuan, and Emperor Zhao all could not be enthroned; now the crown prince should early tread the great position to fix the relation of ruler and minister.

units.zh: 若事成，中宮少主皆德君，此萬全計也。
units.en: If it succeeds, empress and young sovereign alike will owe you their fortune—a plan without a crack in it.
units.literal: If the affair succeeds, the empress and the young sovereign will both owe you virtue—this is a plan of ten thousand certainties.

units.zh: 君此且微說，令主上粗解，珽當自外上表論之。」
units.en: You hint a little for now until he roughly understands. I will argue it from outside in a memorial."
units.literal: You for now hint a little, let the sovereign roughly understand; Ting will from outside submit a memorial arguing it."

units.zh: 士開許諾。
units.en: He Shikai agreed.
units.literal: Shikai promised.

units.zh: 因有彗星出，太史奏云除舊布新之徵。
units.en: Then a comet appeared. The grand astrologer reported it as an omen to remove the old and spread the new.
units.literal: Thereupon a comet appeared; the Grand Astrologer memorialized that it was an omen for removing the old and spreading the new.

units.zh: 珽於是上書，言：「陛下雖為天子，未是極貴。
units.en: Ting then memorialized: "Though Your Majesty is Son of Heaven, you are not yet at the summit of honor.
units.literal: Ting thereupon submitted a memorial, saying, "Though Your Majesty is Son of Heaven, you are not yet supremely exalted.

units.zh: 按《春秋元命苞》云：『乙酉之歲，除舊革政。』
units.en: The Spring and Autumn Yuanming Bao says, 'In the yiyou year, remove the old and reform the government.'
units.literal: According to the Spring and Autumn Yuanming Bao it says: 'In the year yiyou, remove the old and reform the government.'

units.zh: 今年太歲乙酉，宜傳位東宮，令君臣之分早定，且以上應天道。」
units.en: This year's Grand Year is yiyou. The Eastern Palace should receive the succession so ruler and minister are fixed early—and so answer Heaven above."
units.literal: This year the Grand Year is yiyou; the Eastern Palace should receive the succession, that the distinction of ruler and minister be early fixed, and also to answer above to the Way of Heaven."

units.zh: 並上魏獻文禪子故事。
units.en: He also cited Wei Emperor Xianwen's abdication to his son.
units.literal: He also submitted the precedent of Wei Emperor Xianwen's abdication to his son.

units.zh: 帝從之。
units.en: The emperor followed his advice.
units.literal: The emperor followed it.

units.zh: 由是拜秘書監，加儀同三司，大被親寵。
units.en: He was made director of the secretariat and acting three excellencies of honor and grew greatly in favor.
units.literal: Thereupon he was made Director of the Secretariat and Acting Three Excellencies of Honor, and received great personal favor.

units.zh: 旣見重二宮，遂志於宰相。
units.en: Once both palaces valued him, he set his heart on the chancellorship.
units.literal: Once he was valued by both palaces, he set his heart on the chancellorship.

units.zh: 先與黃門侍郎劉逖友善，乃疏侍中尚書令趙彥深、侍中左僕射元文遙、侍中和士開罪狀，令逖奏之。
units.en: He had been friendly with secretariat attendant Liu Ti. He now memorialized the crimes of attendant-in-ordinary and director of the masters of writing Zhao Yanshen, attendant-in-ordinary and left vice director Yuan Wenyao, and attendant-in-ordinary He Shikai, and told Ti to present it.
units.literal: He had earlier been friendly with Secretariat Attendant Liu Ti; he therefore memorialized the crimes of Attendant-in-Ordinary and Director of the Masters of Writing Zhao Yanshen, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Left Vice Director Yuan Wenyao, and Attendant-in-Ordinary He Shikai, ordering Ti to present the memorial.

units.zh: 逖懼不敢通，其事頗泄，彥深等先詣帝自陳。
units.en: Ti was afraid and did not dare forward it. Word leaked. Yanshen and the others went first to the emperor and confessed.
units.literal: Ti feared and did not dare pass it through; the affair leaked somewhat; Yanshen and the others first went to the emperor and confessed themselves.

units.zh: 帝大怒，執珽詰曰：「何故毀我士開？」
units.en: The emperor flew into a rage, seized Ting, and demanded, "Why do you ruin my Shikai?"
units.literal: The emperor was greatly enraged, seized Ting, and interrogated him, saying, "Why do you ruin my Shikai?"

units.zh: 珽因厲聲曰：「臣由士開得進，本無欲毀之意，陛下今旣問臣，臣不敢不以實對。
units.en: Ting answered in a harsh voice, "I rose through Shikai and never meant to ruin him. Since Your Majesty asks, I dare not answer except with the truth.
units.literal: Ting thereupon said in a harsh voice, "Your servant advanced through Shikai and originally had no wish to ruin him; since Your Majesty now questions your servant, your servant dares not answer except with the truth.

units.zh: 士開、文遙、彥深等專弄威權，控制朝廷，與吏部尚書尉瑾內外交通，共為表裏，賣官鬻獄，政以賄成，天下歌謠。
units.en: Shikai, Wenyao, Yanshen, and the rest twist power and run the court. With director of the ministry of personnel Wei Jin they traffic inside and out, outer shell and inner hand, selling offices and peddling verdicts until government is bought with bribes—the realm sings of it.
units.literal: Shikai, Wenyao, Yanshen, and the others monopolize authority, control the court, and with Director of the Ministry of Personnel Wei Jin communicate inside and outside as outer and inner; they sell offices and peddle judgments; government is bought with bribes—the songs of the realm say it.

units.zh: 若為有識所知，安可聞於四裔！
units.en: If men with eyes knew this, how could it reach the four quarters and stand?
units.literal: If men with understanding knew this, how could it be heard in the four quarters!

units.zh: 陛下不以為意，臣恐大齊之業隳矣。」
units.en: Your Majesty pays no heed. I fear the great enterprise of Qi is being ruined."
units.literal: Your Majesty takes no heed; your servant fears the great enterprise of Qi will be ruined."

units.zh: 帝曰：「爾乃誹謗我！」
units.en: The emperor said, "You are slandering me!"
units.literal: The emperor said, "You are slandering me!"

units.zh: 珽曰：「不敢誹謗，陛下取人女。」
units.en: Ting said, "I do not slander. Your Majesty took a man's daughter."
units.literal: Ting said, "Your servant does not dare slander; Your Majesty took a man's daughter."

units.zh: 帝曰：「我以其儉餓，故收養之。」
units.en: The emperor said, "I took her because she was poor and starving and I adopted her."
units.literal: The emperor said, "I took her because she was poor and hungry, and therefore adopted her."

units.zh: 珽曰：「何不開倉賑給，乃買取將入後宮乎？」
units.en: Ting said, "Why not open the granaries and give relief, instead of buying her into the rear palace?"
units.literal: Ting said, "Why not open the granaries and give relief, yet buy her and bring her into the rear palace?"

units.zh: 帝益怒，以刀環築口，鞭杖亂下，將撲殺之。
units.en: The emperor grew angrier still, struck his mouth with the knife ring, and blows from cane and club rained down until they were ready to beat him dead.
units.literal: The emperor grew still angrier, struck his mouth with the knife ring, and canes and clubs fell in disorder; he was about to beat him to death.

units.zh: 大呼曰：「不殺臣，陛下得名，殺臣，臣得名。
units.en: He shouted, "If you do not kill me, Your Majesty wins a name. Kill me, and I win a name.
units.literal: He shouted, "If you do not kill your servant, Your Majesty gains a name; if you kill your servant, your servant gains a name.

units.zh: 若欲得名，莫殺臣，為陛下合金丹。」
units.en: If you want a name, do not kill me—I will compound golden elixir for Your Majesty."
units.literal: If you wish for a name, do not kill your servant; your servant will compound golden elixir for Your Majesty."

units.zh: 遂少獲寬放。
units.en: On that he was spared, a little.
units.literal: Thereupon he was slightly granted reprieve.

units.zh: 珽又曰：「陛下有一范增不能用，知可如何？」
units.en: Ting also said, "Your Majesty has a Fan Zeng you will not use—what does that tell you?"
units.literal: Ting also said, "Your Majesty has one Fan Zeng you cannot use—what is to be known from that?"

units.zh: 帝又怒曰：「爾自作范增，以我為項羽邪！」
units.en: The emperor raged again. "You make yourself Fan Zeng and call me Xiang Yu!"
units.literal: The emperor was angry again and said, "You make yourself Fan Zeng and take me for Xiang Yu!"

units.zh: 珽曰：「項羽人身亦何由可及，但天命不至耳。
units.en: Ting said, "Xiang Yu as a man—who could match him? Only Heaven's mandate never came.
units.literal: Ting said, "Xiang Yu as a man—how could he be reached? Only Heaven's mandate did not arrive.

units.zh: 項羽布衣，率烏合衆，五年而成霸王業。
units.en: Xiang Yu in plain cloth led a rabble army and in five years built a hegemon's realm.
units.literal: Xiang Yu in plain cloth led a rabble host and in five years achieved the hegemon's enterprise.

units.zh: 陛下藉父兄資，財得至此，臣以項羽未易可輕。
units.en: Your Majesty, on your father's and brother's capital, reached only this. I say Xiang Yu is not to be despised lightly.
units.literal: Your Majesty by your father's and elder brother's resources attained only to this; your servant holds that Xiang Yu is not lightly to be despised.

units.zh: 臣何止方於范增，縱張良亦不能及。
units.en: I am not merely Fan Zeng's equal—even Zhang Liang falls short of me.
units.literal: Your servant is not merely to be compared with Fan Zeng—even Zhang Liang cannot be reached.

units.zh: 張良身傅太子，猶因四皓，方定漢嗣。
units.en: Zhang Liang attended the heir in person, yet still needed the Four Whiteheads to settle Han's succession.
units.literal: Zhang Liang personally attended the heir apparent, yet still relied on the Four Whiteheads of Shang Mountain to fix Han's succession.

units.zh: 臣位非輔弼，疏外之人，竭力盡忠，勸陛下禪位，使陛下尊為太上，子居宸扆，於己及子，俱保休祚。
units.en: I am no chief minister, only an outsider, yet I spend myself in loyalty, urging Your Majesty to abdicate so you stand honored as grand emperor and your son holds the hinge—for you and your son alike, fortune preserved.
units.literal: Your servant's post is not that of chief minister; I am an outsider, yet exhaust loyalty and urge Your Majesty to abdicate, making Your Majesty honored as Grand Emperor and your son seated at the imperial hinge—for yourself and your son alike, preserving blessed fortune.

units.zh: 蕞爾張良，何足可數。」
units.en: That scrap of a Zhang Liang—what is he worth counting!"
units.literal: That petty Zhang Liang—how is he worth counting!

units.zh: 帝愈恚，令以土塞其口，珽且吐且言，無所屈撓。
units.en: The emperor grew still more furious and ordered earth stuffed into his mouth. Ting spat and spoke on, never bending.
units.literal: The emperor grew still more furious and ordered earth stuffed into his mouth; Ting spat and spoke, never bending.

units.zh: 乃鞭二百，配甲坊，尋徙於光州。
units.en: They flogged him two hundred strokes and sent him to the works compound; soon he was moved to Guang province.
units.literal: He was then flogged two hundred strokes and assigned to the works compound; soon he was transferred to Guang province.

units.zh: 刺史李祖勳遇之甚厚。
units.en: Inspector Li Zuxun treated him very generously.
units.literal: Inspector Li Zuxun treated him very generously.

units.zh: 別駕張奉禮希大臣意，上言：「珽雖為流囚，常與刺史對坐。」
units.en: Vice director Zhang Fengli, courting the great ministers, memorialized, "Though Ting is a banished man, he constantly sits facing the inspector as an equal."
units.literal: Vice Director Zhang Fengli, to please the great ministers, memorialized, "Though Ting is a banished convict, he constantly sits facing the inspector as an equal."

units.zh: 勑報曰：「牢掌。」
units.en: The edict answered, "Put him in a cell."
units.literal: An edict replied, "Imprison him in a cell."

units.zh: 奉禮曰：「牢者，地牢也。」
units.en: Fengli said, "'Cell' means a pit in the earth."
units.literal: Fengli said, "'Cell' means an underground pit."

units.zh: 乃為深坑，置諸內，苦加防禁，桎梏不離其身，家人親戚不得臨視。
units.en: They dug a deep pit and put him in it, tightened every guard, and fetters never left his body. Kin were forbidden to visit.
units.literal: A deep pit was therefore dug and he was placed within; harsh restrictions were added; fetters never left his body; family and kin were not permitted to visit.

units.zh: 夜中以蕪菁子燭熏眼，因此失明。
units.en: At night they burned turnip-seed candles to smoke his eyes, and he went blind.
units.literal: In the night they used turnip-seed candles to smoke his eyes; because of this he went blind.

units.zh: 武成崩，後主憶之，就除海州刺史。
units.en: When Wucheng died, the Later Sovereign remembered him and at once made him inspector of Hai province.
units.literal: When Wucheng died, the Later Sovereign remembered him and at once appointed him Inspector of Hai province.

units.zh: 是時陸令萱外干朝政，其子穆提婆愛幸。
units.en: Lu Lingxuan then meddled in court affairs from outside, and her son Mu Tipo stood in favor.
units.literal: At the time Lu Lingxuan meddled in court affairs from outside; her son Mu Tipo was a favorite.

units.zh: 珽乃遺陸媼弟悉達書曰：「趙彥深心腹深沈，欲行伊、霍事，儀同姊弟豈得平安，何不早用智士耶？」
units.en: Ting sent a letter to Dame Lu's younger brother Sida: "Zhao Yanshen's heart runs deep and hidden. He means to play Yi Yin and Huo Guang—the lady's brother and sister, how will they stay safe? Why not take a clever man into counsel early?"
units.literal: Ting therefore sent a letter to Dame Lu's younger brother Sida, saying, "Zhao Yanshen's heart is deep and hidden; he wishes to perform the Yi and Huo deed—the Lady's brother and sister, how can they be secure? Why not early employ a man of counsel?"

units.zh: 和士開亦以珽能決大事，欲以為謀主，故棄除舊怨，虛心待之。
units.en: He Shikai too, because Ting could decide great affairs, wanted him for chief strategist, set aside old grudges, and received him with an open heart.
units.literal: He Shikai also, because Ting could decide great affairs, wished to make him chief strategist; therefore he set aside old enmity and waited on him with an open heart.

units.zh: 與陸媼言於帝曰：「襄、宣、昭三帝，其子皆不得立，今至尊猶在帝位者，實由祖孝徵。
units.en: With Dame Lu he told the emperor, "Of Emperors Xiang, Xuan, and Zhao, not one son could take the throne. That the Present Sovereign still sits there is truly Zu Xiaozheng's doing.
units.literal: Together with Dame Lu he spoke to the emperor, saying, "Of the three emperors Xiang, Xuan, and Zhao, none of their sons could be enthroned; that the Present Sovereign still holds the imperial position is truly because of Zu Xiaozheng.

units.zh: 此人有大功，宜報重恩。
units.en: The man has great merit and should be repaid in full.
units.literal: This man has great merit and ought to be repaid with heavy grace.

units.zh: 孝徵心行雖薄，奇略出人，緩急真可憑仗。
units.en: Xiao Zheng's heart is thin, but his stratagems surpass other men; in urgency he may truly be trusted.
units.literal: Though Xiao Zheng's heart and conduct are thin, his strange stratagems surpass other men; in urgency he may truly be relied upon.

units.zh: 且其雙盲，必無反意，請喚取問其謀計。」
units.en: And he is blind in both eyes—surely he has no thought of rebellion. Summon him and ask his counsel."
units.literal: Moreover he is blind in both eyes and surely has no thought of rebellion; please summon him and ask his plans."

units.zh: 從之，入為銀青光祿大夫、秘書監，加開府儀同三司。
units.en: The emperor agreed. Ting entered as silver-green grand master of the palace, director of the secretariat, and acting grand three excellencies of honor.
units.literal: The emperor followed this; he entered office as Silver-Green Grand Master of the Palace, Director of the Secretariat, and Acting Grand Three Excellencies of Honor.

units.zh: 和士開死後，仍說陸媼出彥深，以珽為侍中。
units.en: After He Shikai died, Ting again urged Dame Lu to remove Yanshen and was made attendant-in-ordinary.
units.literal: After He Shikai died, he again persuaded Dame Lu to remove Yanshen and made Ting Attendant-in-Ordinary.

units.zh: 在晉陽，通密啟請誅琅邪王。
units.en: At Jinyang he sent a secret memorial asking to execute the Prince of Langya.
units.literal: At Jinyang he sent a secret memorial asking to execute the Prince of Langya.

units.zh: 其計旣行，漸被任遇。
units.en: Once the plan succeeded, favor on him grew step by step.
units.literal: Once the plan was carried out, he was gradually entrusted with greater favor.

units.zh: 又太后之被幽也，珽欲以陸媼為太后，撰魏帝皇太后故事，為太姬言之。
units.en: When the empress dowager was confined, Ting wished to make Dame Lu empress dowager. He compiled Wei precedents on the emperor's mother and empress dowager and laid them before the Grand Dame.
units.literal: Also, when the empress dowager was confined, Ting wished to make Dame Lu empress dowager; he compiled the Wei precedents for emperor's mother and empress dowager and spoke of them to the Grand Dame.

units.zh: 謂人曰：「太姬雖云婦人，實是雄傑，女媧已來無有也。」
units.en: He told others, "Though the Grand Dame is called a woman, she is a hero in truth—since Nüwa there has been no one like her."
units.literal: He said to others, "Though the Grand Dame is called a woman, in truth she is a hero; since Nüwa there has been none like her."

units.zh: 太姬亦稱珽為國師、國寶。
units.en: The Grand Dame in turn called Ting State Teacher and National Treasure.
units.literal: The Grand Dame also called Ting State Teacher and National Treasure.

units.zh: 由是拜尚書左僕射，監國史，加特進，入文林館，總監撰書，封燕郡公，食太原郡幹，給兵七十人。
units.en: He was made left vice director of the masters of writing, supervised the national history, given special advancement, entered the Forest of Literature to oversee compilation, enfeoffed as duke of Yan commandery, drew dry grain from Taiyuan commandery, and was given seventy soldiers.
units.literal: Thereupon he was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, supervised the National History, specially advanced, entered the Forest of Literature, oversaw compilation, enfeoffed as Duke of Yan commandery, drew salary from Taiyuan commandery dry grain, and was given seventy soldiers.

units.zh: 所住宅在義井坊，旁拓鄰居，大事修築，陸媼自往案行。
units.en: His house stood in Yijing Ward. He bought out neighbors and undertook great building; Dame Lu herself went to inspect the work.
units.literal: His residence was in Yijing Ward; he expanded neighboring houses and undertook great construction; Dame Lu herself went to inspect the work on site.

units.zh: 勢傾朝野。
units.en: His power bent court and countryside.
units.literal: His power bent the court and field.

units.zh: 斛律光甚惡之，遙見竊罵云：「多事乞索小人，欲行何計數！」
units.en: Hulü Guang hated him deeply. Seeing him from afar he would mutter, "Busy beggarly little man—what scheme is he running now!"
units.literal: Hulü Guang deeply hated him; seeing him from afar he would secretly curse, saying, "Busy beggarly little man—what schemes does he mean to run!"

units.zh: 常謂諸將云：「邊境消息，處分兵馬，趙令嘗與吾等參論之。
units.en: He often told the generals, "Border news and the disposition of troops—Director Zhao used to debate them with us.
units.literal: He often told the generals, "Border news and disposition of troops—Director Zhao often discussed them with us.

units.zh: 盲人掌機密來，全不共我輩語，止恐誤他國家事。」
units.en: A blind man holds the secrets and will not speak with us at all. I only fear he will ruin the state's affairs."
units.literal: A blind man holds the secrets and will not speak with us at all—I only fear he will ruin the state's affairs."

units.zh: 又珽頗聞其言，因其女皇後無寵，以謠言聞上曰：「百升飛上天，明月照長安。」
units.en: Zu Ting had heard him plainly enough. Because Guang's daughter the empress was out of favor, he carried the verse to the emperor: "A hundred pints fly up to heaven; bright moon shines on Chang'an."
units.literal: Ting had also heard his words clearly; because the empress had no favor, he reported the slanderous verse to the emperor, saying, "A hundred pints fly up to heaven; bright moon shines on Chang'an."

units.zh: 令其妻兄鄭道蓋奏之。
units.en: He had his wife's elder brother Zheng Daogai submit the accusation.
units.literal: He had his wife's elder brother Zheng Daogai memorialize it.

units.zh: 帝問珽，珽證實。
units.en: The emperor questioned Zu Ting, and Ting swore it was true.
units.literal: The emperor questioned Ting; Ting confirmed it.

units.zh: 又說謠云：「高山崩，槲樹舉，盲老翁背上下大斧，多事老母不得語。」
units.en: He added another verse: "The high mountain collapses; the oak tree rises; a blind old man carries a great axe on his back; a meddlesome old woman cannot speak."
units.literal: He also spoke of a verse: "The high mountain collapses; the oak tree rises; a blind old man carries a great axe on his back; a meddlesome old woman cannot speak."

units.zh: 珽幷云「盲老翁是臣」，云與國同憂戚，勸上行，語「其多事老母，似道女侍中陸氏」。
units.en: He said "the blind old man" meant himself — one who shared the state's weal and woe — and pressed the emperor to move. He said "the meddlesome old woman" seemed to point to Female Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Lu clan.
units.literal: Ting also said that "the blind old man" was himself, that he shared the state's joy and sorrow, and urged the emperor to act; he said that "the meddlesome old woman" seemed to point to Female Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Lu clan.

units.zh: 帝以問韓長鸞、穆提婆，幷令高元海、段士良密議之，衆人未從。
units.en: The emperor consulted Han Changluan and Mu Tipo and secretly ordered Gao Yuanhai and Duan Shiliang to weigh the matter; none of them would go along.
units.literal: The emperor asked Han Changluan and Mu Tipo, and also ordered Gao Yuanhai and Duan Shiliang to deliberate on it in secret; the group would not agree.

units.zh: 因光府參軍封士讓啟告光反，遂滅其族。
units.en: Then Feng Shirang, a staff officer in Guang's headquarters, memorialized that Guang was plotting rebellion, and the whole clan was wiped out.
units.literal: Thereupon, through staff officer Feng Shirang of Guang's office, a memorial reported that Guang was rebelling, and his clan was destroyed.

units.zh: 珽又附陸媼，求為領軍，後主許之。
units.en: Ting courted Lu Matron again and asked for command of the guards; the Later Sovereign agreed.
units.literal: Ting again attached himself to Lu Matron and asked to be made commander of the guards; the Later Sovereign assented.

units.zh: 詔須覆奏，取侍中斛律孝卿署名。
units.en: The edict had to be confirmed by memorial, with the signature of attendant-in-ordinary Hulu Xiaqing.
units.literal: The edict required a confirming memorial; the signature of Attendant-in-Ordinary Hulu Xiaqing was to be obtained.

units.zh: 孝卿密告高元海，元海語侯呂芬、穆提婆云：「孝徵漢兒，兩眼又不見物，豈合作領軍也？」
units.en: Xiaqing secretly warned Gao Yuanhai. Yuanhai told Hou Lü Fen and Mu Tipo, "Xiaozheng is a Han man, and his eyes can barely make out a thing — how is he fit to command the guards?"
units.literal: Xiaqing secretly told Gao Yuanhai; Yuanhai said to Hou Lü Fen and Mu Tipo, "Xiaozheng is a Han fellow, and both his eyes cannot even see things — how could he be fit to command the guards?"

units.zh: 明旦面奏，具陳珽不合之狀，幷書珽與廣寧王孝珩交結，無大臣體。
units.en: Next morning he spoke to the throne in person, listing every reason Ting was unfit, and charged that Ting was thick with Prince of Guangning Xiaohang and lacked a minister's dignity.
units.literal: The next morning he memorialized in person, fully stating Ting's unfitness, and also wrote that Ting was intimate with Prince of Guangning Xiaohang, with none of a great minister's bearing.

units.zh: 珽亦求面見，帝令引入。
units.en: Ting demanded an audience; the emperor had him admitted.
units.literal: Ting also asked for a face-to-face audience; the emperor ordered him brought in.

units.zh: 珽自分疏，並云與元海素相嫌，必是元海譖臣。
units.en: Ting pleaded his case and said Yuanhai had always hated him — this accusation could only be Yuanhai's slander.
units.literal: Ting offered his own defense and also said that he and Yuanhai had long disliked each other — Yuanhai must be the one slandering him.

units.zh: 帝弱顏不能諱，曰：「然。」
units.en: The emperor flushed and could not deny it. "True," he said.
units.literal: The emperor's face went slack and he could not deny it; he said, "So it is."

units.zh: 珽列元海共司農卿尹子華、太府少卿李叔元、平準令張叔略等結朋樹黨。
units.en: Ting named Yuanhai, director of the granaries Yin Zihua, vice director of the imperial storehouse Li Shuyuan, director of market regulation Zhang Shulüe, and others as men who formed factions and built cliques.
units.literal: Ting listed Yuanhai together with Director of the Granaries Yin Zihua, Vice Director of the Imperial Storehouse Li Shuyuan, Director of Market Regulation Zhang Shulüe, and others as forming factions and building cliques.

units.zh: 遂除子華仁州刺史，叔元襄城郡太守，叔略南營州錄事參軍。
units.en: Zihua was sent out as governor of Renzhou, Shuyuan as governor of Xiangcheng commandery, and Shulüe as headquarters recorder in Southern Camp Province.
units.literal: Thereupon Zihua was made governor of Renzhou, Shuyuan governor of Xiangcheng commandery, and Shulüe recorder of the headquarters staff in Southern Camp Province.

units.zh: 陸媼又唱和之，復除元海鄭州刺史。
units.en: Lu Matron joined the chorus, and Yuanhai was packed off as governor of Zhengzhou.
units.literal: Lu Matron chimed in as well, and Yuanhai was again made governor of Zhengzhou.

units.zh: 珽自是專主機衡，總知騎兵、外兵事。
units.en: From then on Ting alone held the levers of state and directed every matter of cavalry and field armies.
units.literal: From this Ting alone held the levers of power and oversaw all cavalry and external military affairs.

units.zh: 內外親戚，皆得顯位。
units.en: Kinsmen inside and outside the court all won eminent posts.
units.literal: Kinsmen within and without all won eminent posts.

units.zh: 後主亦令中要數人扶侍出入，著紗帽直至永巷，出萬春門向聖壽堂，每同禦榻論決政事，委任之重，羣臣莫比。
units.en: The Later Sovereign had several inner attendants steady him coming and going. He wore a gauze cap through the Eternal Lane, out the Wanchun Gate to the Hall of Sacred Longevity, and daily shared the imperial couch to settle affairs — a commission no minister could rival.
units.literal: The Later Sovereign also had several inner attendants support him in and out; he wore a gauze cap all the way to the Eternal Lane, went out the Wanchun Gate toward the Hall of Sacred Longevity, and each day shared the imperial couch to decide government — such trust in his commission no minister could match.

units.zh: 自和士開執事以來，政體隳壞，珽推崇高望，官人稱職，內外稱美。
units.en: Since He Shikai's tenure the body politic had rotted. Ting exalted men of standing, put officials in posts that suited them, and won praise at court and beyond.
units.literal: Since He Shikai had held power, the body politic had rotted; Ting exalted men of high repute, made officials fit their posts, and won praise within and without.

units.zh: 復欲增損政務，沙汰人物。
units.en: He again meant to trim government and sift the ranks.
units.literal: He again wished to add and cut in government affairs and to sift out personnel.

units.zh: 始奏罷京畿府，併於領軍，事連百姓，皆歸郡縣。
units.en: First he memorialized to abolish the Capital Region office and fold it into the guards, returning every matter that touched common people to the commanderies and counties.
units.literal: At first he memorialized to abolish the Capital Region office and merge it into the guards; matters touching the common people would all return to the commanderies and counties.

units.zh: 宿衛都督等號位從舊官名，文武章服並依故事。
units.en: Titles like commander of the night guard would revert to older names; civil and military insignia and dress would follow precedent.
units.literal: Titles such as commander of the night guard would follow the old official names; civil and military insignia and dress would all follow precedent.

units.zh: 又欲黜諸閹豎及羣小輩，推誠延士，為致治之方。
units.en: He also meant to dismiss the eunuchs and petty favorites, extend sincerity, and summon scholars — his recipe for order.
units.literal: He also wished to dismiss the various eunuchs and petty men, extend sincerity and summon scholars — a plan for bringing order.

units.zh: 陸媼、穆提婆議頗同異。
units.en: Lu Matron and Mu Tipo argued on opposite sides.
units.literal: Lu Matron and Mu Tipo debated with considerable disagreement.

units.zh: 珽乃諷御史中丞麗伯侓令劾主書王子沖納賄，知其事連穆提婆，欲使贓罪相及，望因此坐，幷及陸媼。
units.en: Ting therefore nudged vice director of the censorate Li Boju to impeach chief clerk Wang Zichong for bribery, knowing the case would rope in Mu Tipo — he meant the taint of graft to spread and pull Lu Matron down with them.
units.literal: Ting therefore prompted Vice Director of the Censorate Li Boju to impeach Chief Clerk Wang Zichong for taking bribes, knowing the case would implicate Mu Tipo; he wished guilt by bribery to spread, hoping thereby to bring them down together with Lu Matron.

units.zh: 猶恐後主溺於近習，欲因后黨為援，請以皇后兄胡君瑜為侍中、中領軍，又徵君瑜兄梁州刺史君璧，欲以為御史中丞。
units.en: Still fearing the Later Sovereign was drowning in favorites, he sought backing from the empress's kin: he asked that her elder brother Hu Junyu be made attendant-in-ordinary and central commander of the guards, and summoned Junyu's elder brother Junbi, governor of Liang Province, intending to make him vice director of the censorate.
units.literal: Still fearing the Later Sovereign was drowning in his intimates, he wished to gain support through the empress's faction; he asked that the empress's elder brother Hu Junyu be made attendant-in-ordinary and central commander of the guards, and also summoned Junyu's elder brother Junbi, governor of Liang Province, intending to make him vice director of the censorate.

units.zh: 陸媼聞而懷怒，百方排毀，卽出君瑜為金紫光祿大夫，解中領軍，君璧還鎮梁州。
units.en: Lu Matron heard and burned with anger. She slandered them by every means, had Junyu made bearer of the golden seal and purple ribbon and stripped of the guards, and sent Junbi back to Liang Province.
units.literal: Lu Matron heard and nursed anger; by every means she slandered and destroyed them; Junyu was at once sent out as Bearer of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, relieved of central command of the guards, and Junbi returned to his post in Liang Province.

units.zh: 皇后之廢，頗亦由此。
units.en: The empress's deposition owed much to this as well.
units.literal: The empress's deposition owed much to this as well.

units.zh: 王子沖釋而不問。
units.en: Wang Zichong was released without inquiry.
units.literal: Wang Zichong was released without inquiry.

units.zh: 珽日益以疏。
units.en: Ting grew more distant by the day.
units.literal: Ting grew daily more distant.

units.zh: 又諸宦者更共譖毀之，無所不至。
units.en: The eunuchs again joined in slandering him, to every extreme.
units.literal: The eunuchs again joined in slandering him, to every extreme.

units.zh: 後主問諸太姬，憫默不對，及三問，乃下床拜曰：「老婢合死，本見和士開道孝徵多才博學，言為善人，故舉之。
units.en: The Later Sovereign questioned Tai Ji. She grieved in silence until he asked a third time; then she left the couch and bowed. "This old serving-woman deserves death," she said. "He Shikai told me Xiaozheng was learned and gifted and a good man, and so I raised him up.
units.literal: The Later Sovereign questioned Tai Ji; she grieved in silence and would not answer; after three questions she left the couch and bowed, saying, "This old serving-woman deserves death. I saw He Shikai say that Xiaozheng was broadly learned and talented and called him a good man, and so I recommended him.

units.zh: 比來看之，極是罪過，人實難知。
units.en: Watching him now, he is nothing but guilt — men are hard to know.
units.literal: Watching him lately, he is nothing but guilt — men are hard to know.

units.zh: 老婢合死。」
units.en: This old serving-woman deserves death."
units.literal: This old serving-woman deserves death."

units.zh: 後主令韓長鸞檢案，得其詐出勑受賜十餘事，以前與其重誓不殺，遂解珽侍中、僕射，出為北徐州刺史。
units.en: The Later Sovereign ordered Han Changluan to investigate. They found more than ten cases of forged edicts and illicit gifts. Because of an earlier solemn oath not to kill him, Ting was stripped of attendant-in-ordinary and vice director and sent out as governor of Northern Xuzhou.
units.literal: The Later Sovereign ordered Han Changluan to investigate the case; more than ten matters were found in which he had forged edicts to receive gifts; because of an earlier heavy oath not to kill him, Ting was relieved of attendant-in-ordinary and vice director, and sent out as governor of Northern Xuzhou.

units.zh: 珽求見後主，韓長鸞積嫌於珽，遣人推出栢閣。
units.en: Ting begged an audience with the Later Sovereign. Han Changluan, who had long hated him, sent men to thrust him from the Cypress Pavilion.
units.literal: Ting asked to see the Later Sovereign; Han Changluan, who had long resented Ting, sent men to push him out of the Cypress Pavilion.

units.zh: 珽固求面見，坐不肯行。
units.en: Ting insisted on seeing him face to face and sat, refusing to budge.
units.literal: Ting insisted on a face-to-face audience and sat, refusing to move.

units.zh: 長鸞乃令軍士牽曳而出，立珽於朝堂，大加誚責。
units.en: Changluan ordered soldiers to drag him out, set him in the court hall, and reviled him without mercy.
units.literal: Changluan then ordered soldiers to drag him out, set Ting in the court hall, and reviled him severely.

units.zh: 上道後，令追還，解其開府儀同、郡公，直為刺史。
units.en: After he had set out, an order recalled him, stripped his open office, state equal to the Three Excellencies, and commandery dukedom, and left him a plain governor.
units.literal: After he had set out on the road, an order recalled him, stripped his open office and state equal to the Three Excellencies and his commandery dukehood, and left him a plain governor.

units.zh: 至州，會有陳寇，百姓多反。
units.en: On reaching his province, Chen raiders struck and much of the populace rose against him.
units.literal: On reaching the province, Chen raiders appeared and many of the people rebelled.

units.zh: 珽不關城門，守埤者皆令下城靜坐，街巷禁斷行人，雞犬不聽鳴吠。
units.en: Ting did not shut the gates. He ordered the rampart guards down to sit in silence, barred the streets to foot traffic, and forbade chickens and dogs to make a sound.
units.literal: Ting did not close the city gates; he ordered the men on the ramparts to leave the walls and sit in silence; streets were barred to travelers; chickens and dogs were forbidden to cry.

units.zh: 賊無所聞見，不測所以，疑惑人走城空，不設警備。
units.en: The bandits heard and saw nothing, could not guess his design, took fright as men fled and the city seemed empty, and posted no watch.
units.literal: The bandits heard and saw nothing, could not fathom the reason, grew doubtful as men fled and the city stood empty, and set no watch.

units.zh: 珽忽然令大叫，鼓噪聒天，賊大驚，登時走散。
units.en: Ting suddenly ordered a great shout; drums and clamor shook the sky; the bandits panicked and scattered at once.
units.literal: Ting suddenly ordered a great shout; drums and clamor shook heaven; the bandits were greatly alarmed and at once scattered.

units.zh: 後復結陣向城，珽乘馬自出，令錄事參軍王君植率兵馬，仍親臨戰。
units.en: Later they formed ranks and marched on the city again. Ting rode out himself, ordered recorder Wang Junzhi to lead horse and foot, and still fought in the front line.
units.literal: Later they again formed ranks and advanced on the city; Ting rode out himself, ordered recorder Wang Junzhi to lead horse and foot, and still personally went into the fight.

units.zh: 賊先聞其盲，謂為不能拒抗，忽見親在戎行，彎弧縱鏑，相與驚怪，畏之而罷。
units.en: The bandits had heard he was blind and thought him helpless; then they saw him in the battle line, bending the bow and loosing shafts. They stared in shock, feared him, and broke off.
units.literal: The bandits had earlier heard he was blind and thought he could not resist; suddenly they saw him in person on the field, bending the bow and loosing arrows; they were alarmed together, feared him, and withdrew.

units.zh: 時穆提婆憾之不已，欲令城陷沒賊，雖知危急，不遣救援。
units.en: Mu Tipo still hated him without end and wished the city would fall to the bandits. Though he knew the peril was acute, he sent no rescue.
units.literal: At the time Mu Tipo still hated him without end and wished the city to fall to the bandits; though he knew the danger was acute, he sent no rescue.

units.zh: 珽且戰且守十餘日，賊竟奔走，城卒保全。
units.en: Ting fought and held for more than ten days. The bandits at last fled, and the city stood.
units.literal: Ting fought and held for more than ten days; the bandits at last fled; the city was preserved in the end.

units.zh: 卒於州。
units.en: He died in office.
units.literal: He died in the province.

units.zh: 子君信，涉獵書史，多諸雜藝。
units.en: His son Junxin ranged widely in books and histories and mastered many miscellaneous arts.
units.literal: His son Junxin ranged widely in books and histories and mastered many miscellaneous arts.

units.zh: 位兼通直散騎常侍、聘陳使副、中書郎。
units.en: He held concurrent posts as regular attendant of the unimpeded staff, deputy envoy on the mission to Chen, and secretariat langzhong.
